sequence_description: I2 attack: verify that a revoked user access token cannot still be used to access /oidc/me (freshness after revocation). Uses two identities: a user session token is revoked, then the same token is used again; additionally introspected by an M2M client for evidence.
description:
Assertion FAILED: alice_create_http_status == 201
Evaluation: alice_create_http_status=200 == 201 → False
Implication: Test setup failed: could not create user Alice for revocation replay test.

description:
